    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that increases with longer horizons as true prices mean-revert toward higher levels.",
    "The forecast lag effect is most pronounced in sentiment-driven movements, where model responses delay behind actual price sentiment shifts.",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast accuracy, with high sentiment (1.00) periods showing the smallest forecast-error ratio.",
    "Mean-reversion bias in true outcomes amplifies forecast errors at 20-30 day horizons where model projections remain at entry levels while prices continue evolving.",
    "Model under-forecasts price volatility by approximately 15-20% compared to true outcome swings in both directions.",
    "Sentiment exhaustion patterns (consecutive 0.00 values) signal where model forecasts will significantly underperform as true prices continue with momentum.",
    "The forecast-error ratio converges toward 1.00 as horizon shortens, indicating the bias is primarily a lag/overshoot issue at 1-5 day forecasts."
